ANL.description: Create Analysis Model File (ANL_REQUEST). Exports an ANL analysis-model file for the given output load set; EXPORT_PATH and LOAD_SET are mandatory, the rest tune the output content.

EXPORT_PATH.description: ANL file export path (destination file path for the generated analysis model).

SELECT_ALL_LOAD_COMB.description: Select all load combinations for output. At least one of SELECT_ALL_LOAD_COMB or SELECT_ALL_LOAD_CASE must be true (both false is rejected).

SELECT_ALL_LOAD_CASE.description: Select all load cases for output. At least one of SELECT_ALL_LOAD_COMB or SELECT_ALL_LOAD_CASE must be true (both false is rejected).

PLATE_OUTPUT_GCSUL.description: Output plate results in the Global Coordinate System (GCS).

BEAM_OUTPUT_DETAIL_OPT.description: Beam output detail option (number of output points along each beam). Case-insensitive; an invalid name is rejected.
